description: Renovate keeps the engine submodule and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions current. Every update arrives as a pull request and has to pass the required checks before it merges.
Auto-merge: minor, patch and digest updates merge through GitHub native auto-merge once those checks pass.
MAJOR updates stay manual, because they can need code changes.
The engine submodule is relay-race-tracker-web-app. Bumping it here is how this page picks up fixes made there.

packageRules.description: Keep major updates manual - they need review before merging.
